data.body_html:
Choosing between the Azimut 39 and the Mangusta 80 for your Marbella charter comes down to budget, group size, and the kind of experience you want. The Azimut 39 is a sleek 12.5m sports cruiser that seats up to 11 guests, with rates starting at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. The Mangusta 80 is a 24m performance yacht that accommodates 12 guests, but requires a minimum 4-hour booking at €4,719—and that includes a free jet ski. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Here’s a detailed cost comparison to help you decide.

Azimut 39 vs Mangusta 80: Pricing at a Glance

Mangusta 8024m12N/A (min 4h)€4,719 (incl. jet ski)Available on request

What’s Included in Both Charters

Every charter from Boat Rental Marbella includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden surcharges. The Azimut 39 rates already cover all of this; the Mangusta 80 rate additionally includes a jet ski for the duration of the charter.

Capacity and Comfort

The Azimut 39 is perfect for smaller groups up to 11, with a comfortable cockpit and a small cabin below. The Mangusta 80 shines with its flybridge, spacious saloon, and large sunpad area—ideal for 12 guests who want room to lounge. If you plan to entertain or host a party, the Mangusta 80’s extra deck space makes a noticeable difference.

Jet Ski Bonus: A Key Differentiator

The Mangusta 80’s free jet ski is a standout feature. You can tow it along the coast and stop for watersports at spots like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. The Azimut 39 does not include a jet ski, but you can still enjoy swimming and snorkelling stops. For thrill-seekers, the Mangusta 80 adds serious value.

Which Boat Fits Your Itinerary?

For a short sunset cruise (2 hours), the Azimut 39 at €749 is the most cost-effective option. For a half-day trip (4 hours), the Mangusta 80 at €4,719 gives you luxury and a jet ski. For a full day (8 hours), the Azimut 39 at €2,299 is unbeatable value. All charters depart from Puerto Banús, giving you easy access to Marbella’s coastline, Cabopino, Estepona, and beyond.

Book Your Marbella Charter

Ready to compare prices and book? Check out our full fleet of boats in Marbella or contact us via WhatsApp for personalised advice. Whether you choose the Azimut 39 or the Mangusta 80, you’ll enjoy a premium experience on the Costa del Sol.
